maya: Scheduling a rolling maintenance in apac-southeast1 Sat 03:00-06:00 local. Cause: NIC microcode + GPU microcode combo to address packet stalls and occasional driver resets. Scope: 4 racks (racks A-D). Aim: apply microcode, reboot, validate nvml + net counters. Expect transient reschedules; reserved pools untouched.

tom: Expected capacity hit? canary plan?

maya: Expect ~5-7% reduction in shared capacity during the work. Canary: rack A at 03:10 (5 nodes) -> observe 15m -> proceed. Serial cohorts after manual go.

ravi: If tail latency spikes, prefer local intra-region backfill (apac-west) over cross-region. Cross-region egress cost is steep overnight.

sophia: Cost ballpark: pulling 10 GPUs from apac-west for 3h ~ $600. US backfill ~ $1.4k. We'll only do extra backfill if p99 > +250ms or error rate +0.4%.

maya: Default mitigation: enable queue-throttles, seed model caches 30m prior, pause heavy batch jobs 02:30-07:00. @ops-bot create ticket and tag jobs.

ops-bot: Ticket created: apac-se1-microcode-6500000123. Link: https://console.internal/maint/6500000123

tom: Runbook snippet: 
```bash
kubectl cordon node-ase1-a{01..05} -n inference
kubectl drain node-ase1-a{01..05} --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=240 -n inference
ssh ops@node-ase1-a01 "sudo /usr/bin/apply-microcode && sudo reboot"
```

sophia: Add 10m manual hold after canary. Ill watch model p95/p99 and cold-starts.

maya: Agreed. Oncall: @tom net, @ravi infra-watch, @sophia ml-perf. Please ACK by EOD.

ravi: ACK

tom: ACK
